newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS - VW, Ford recall minivans.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - VW, Ford recall minivans.

text.p: Carmakers Volkswagen AG and Ford-Werke AG, said on Thursday they were launching a recall action that will affect about 20,000 minivans produced as part of their joint venture in Portugal.
VW and Ford-Werke, the German unit of U.S. carmaker Ford Motor Co, said the recall for vehicles sold throughout Europe is needed to replace a part in the five-point-seatbelt for a child's seat.
VW and Ford said seats with a three-point belt are not affected in vehicle, which was first produced in June 1995.
The minivan is sold under three brand names -- the VW group brands VW Sharan and SEAT Alhambra and the Ford Galaxy.
VW said the problem was uncovered by the carmaker and that there were no complaints from customers. Repairs will be made free of charge and that customers would be notified in the coming days.
